in_sanskrit.name: Sallu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sallu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sallu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sala' which means 'little mountain'. This name is often used in Hindu culture and represents the strength and stability of a mountain. It is also associated with the sun and the moon, symbolizing the balance and harmony in nature.
